page_title: RAY 2-1 MAL | Rayo Vallecano v Mallorca 11/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Juan Martinez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), but it's just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
90+4' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

90+3' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net. The linesman makes the right call and Mallorca will have a corner.
90+3' There's an opportunity for Pablo Torre (Mallorca) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) is penalised for holding. Juan Martinez signals a set piece.
89' The game is interrupted as Pablo Torre (Mallorca) is flagged offside.
89' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
86' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.

84' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
82' The referee awards a corner and Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) goes over to take it.
81' Alvaro Garcia will be replaced by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Maffeo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
81' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Samu Costa will be replaced by Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
80' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

79' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano), but referee Juan Martinez must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
79' It will be a substitution. Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to enter the pitch as Carlos Martin walks off.
78' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) lunges into his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.

76' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
76' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
75' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul and Juan Martinez immediately signals a free kick. It's a free kick to Mallorca in a dangerous position.

74' The fans were almost celebrating as Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal, but Leo Roman made an astonishing save!
73' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
72' Mallorca players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Omar Mascarell departs the field of play to be replaced by Pablo Torre (Mallorca).
70' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Antonio Sanchez as he is replaced by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
69' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Jorge de Frutos.
69' A substitution has been made. Pedro Diaz goes off and Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
68' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) is penalised for a foul. Juan Martinez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
67' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

66' What a chance that is! Samu Costa (Mallorca) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
65' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
64' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
61' Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) for his blatant foul. Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
60' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) picks up an injury.
59' Here comes a substitution. Toni Lato is given a rest as he is replaced by Mateo Joseph (Mallorca).
58' Toni Lato (Mallorca) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
58' A cross is whipped into the box by Johan Mojica (Mallorca) and Vedat Muriqi controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
57' Mallorca seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
56' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
54' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Isi Palazon, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
53' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
49' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fires in a shot from the edge of the box which deflects off one of the defending players and hits the crossbar!
49' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) prepares to take a corner kick.
49' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) launches a cross from the corner, but Leo Roman is alert to thwart the effort. The ball is out of play and Rayo Vallecano manage to earn a corner.

48' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) wastes an opportunity! He unleashed a strong shot from distance after the rebound fell at his feet. It went in the direction of the middle of the target and the goalkeeper pulled off a save to deny him.
46' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Juan Martinez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+10' The match has reached half-time.
45+9' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) takes the corner which is cleared.

45+9' Marash Kumbulla (Mallorca) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball is out of play. Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner.
45+6' The ball is cleared after Jan Virgili (Mallorca) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45+5' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now. Samu Costa (Mallorca) is able to continue to play.

45+4' The game is interrupted now, Samu Costa (Mallorca) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on. Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+3' Samu Costa (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
45+2' The resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

45+2' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Rayo Vallecano can continue in their attacking effort.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
45' The resulting corner from Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared.

45' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Leo Roman shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
42' 2 - 1 Goal! Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Leo Roman to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
42' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
40' The game has begun to heat up. Martin Valjent (Mallorca) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.

40' It looks like Martin Valjent (Mallorca) saw red with that tackle. Juan Martinez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
39' Now Mallorca have a corner.
38' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Inigo Perez is forced to make a change. Andrei Ratiu is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).
37' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

34' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

33' Alvaro Garcia slides a brilliant pass into Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.

30' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) bravely launches himself at a cross from Toni Lato and gives Augusto Batalla no chance with a close-range bullet header into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
29' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
28' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Rayo Vallecano force a corner. They send men into the box.
28' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
27' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
24' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
21' Samu Costa (Mallorca) rises above the defenders and places a towering header low towards the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla is prepared and thwarts him.

21' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

20' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 2:4.

19' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Juan Martinez with no other option than to blow for a foul.
18' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is out of play. Mallorca will take a throw-in.
18' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:1. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
16' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) takes a long-range free kick and whips it into the box. The goalkeeper reads it well and leaps high to intercept the ball.
15' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez had an easy-decision to make.
14' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

14' The Mallorca players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The ball is behind the touchline and Rayo Vallecano will take a throw-in.
12' Rayo Vallecano are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
12' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) sends a chip pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla is quickest to intercept the ball.

10' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) loses the defending players and unloads a powerful, but inaccurate effort from long distance. The goalkeeper remains completely calm as the ball ends near the left corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
9' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) commits a rough foul. Juan Martinez stops the game and makes a call. Mallorca are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
7' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) meets a cross inside the box, but Augusto Batalla wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
6' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Alvaro Garcia. The score is 1:0.
4' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
3' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) plays a one-two with Samu Costa, but the move breaks down.
1' A player from Rayo Vallecano commits a rough challenge. Juan Martinez blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to Mallorca.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Juan Martinez.
